Is the Oris 8.6 easy to use?
The Oris 8.6 has a base EaseScore of 0.8/10. Easescore is a proprietary metric to evaluate how easy a gun is to use. The higher it is, the easier the gun is.

The current Oris 8.6 pick rate is 1.1%. Pick rate is a useful indicator of how popular the weapon is in the current Warzone meta, but it should always be compared with its Loadout quality, TTK, recoil control, and overall ranking.
In which Call of Duty games is the Oris 8.6 meta?
The Oris 8.6 is currently part of the meta in
Warzone
,
Modern Warfare 4
. Its exact ranking and best builds are listed for each game on this page.
How many attachments are available for the Oris 8.6?
The Oris 8.6 can be equipped with 67 different attachments. You can browse them all, with their unlock levels, in the Attachments section above.
How do you unlock camos for the Oris 8.6?
Every camo for the Oris 8.6 has its own challenge to complete, spread across 2 camo grinds:
Weapon Camos
,
Weapon Prestige
. You can track your progress for each of them with the CODMunity camo tracker.
Has the Oris 8.6 been nerfed or buffed recently?
Yes. The Oris 8.6 has received 1 balance adjustments; the most recent one arrived in Season 1 on 06/11/2026. The full balancing history is listed on this page.
Is the Oris 8.6 getting more or less popular?
At the start of the tracked period the Oris 8.6 had a pick rate of 0.00%; it now sits at 1.09%. The daily evolution is charted in the Pick Rate Evolution section above.
